{{Top|leg}}
The '''parabolic guides''' were modifications that linked directly into a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] sensors. This allowed for the calculation of multiple trajectory possibilities for munitions fired at the droid and the evasive maneuvers that were needed.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
